subject.title: feat(ios): resume chat from the afterSeq cursor on reconnect

question: After the thrown older-gateway fallback is fixed, should iOS adopt the `afterSeq` reconnect cursor in this stack now, or wait for the broader mobile reconnect contract to be reviewed together?
rationale: The linked maintainer-labeled workstream adds new Gateway/mobile reconnect behavior, and this PR is stacked on an open protocol PR rather than current main.

options.title: Accept after fallback fix
options.body: Land the iOS adoption after it preserves older-gateway full-history recovery and the gateway cursor base is accepted.

options.title: Pause for full mobile review
options.body: Hold the iOS branch until Android, iOS, and Gateway fallback semantics are reviewed as one contract.

options.title: Keep full refresh for now
options.body: Decline the client cursor adoption and leave reconnect recovery on the existing full-history path until a narrower design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept after fallback fix
recommendation.body: Land the iOS adoption after it preserves older-gateway full-history recovery and the gateway cursor base is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current PR and canonical reconnect workstream and has recent history in the affected Swift chat paths.
